verdict.rationale: Amplitude's session-replay docs explicitly support going "from a chart, funnel, or support ticket to the exact session" [31], tying errors to UX [21], catching errors across sessions [32], and focusing replays on specific users and flows [43], with replays carrying full event and network context [24]. Missing for 10: a documented step-by-step workflow for jumping from a funnel drop-off step or an error event to the affected users' replays, a direct statement that error events link to replays (as opposed to errors merely being visible within replays), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
